description: This file defines a class ConvertDecimal for converting decimal numbers to other number systems such as binary, hexadecimal, and octal, with support for Excel-specific functions and error handling.

classes.name: ConvertDecimal
classes.description: A class providing methods to convert decimal numbers to binary, hex, and octal representations, tailored for Excel functions and handling edge cases.

methods.name: toBinary
methods.description: Converts a decimal value to its binary representation, supporting optional padding and handling of array inputs, with Excel-specific error reporting.

methods.name: toHex
methods.description: Converts a decimal value to its hexadecimal representation, supporting optional padding, handling array inputs, and managing errors as per Excel functions.

methods.name: hex32bit
methods.description: Ensures a hexadecimal string is formatted as a 32-bit representation, handling PHP integer size limitations and sign extension.

methods.name: toOctal
methods.description: Converts a decimal value to its octal representation, supporting padding and array handling, with error checks aligned with Excel.

methods.name: validateDecimal
methods.description: Validates that the input string is a valid decimal number according to specific criteria, throws an exception if invalid.
